_about: Known-bad or outdated mods for tools/compat-scan.ts. Each entry: name (regex, case-insensitive, matched against the file name without extension), optional key (resource key type:group:instance as compat-scan prints it, 8:8:16 hex digits), status (known-bad | outdated | hang-seen: a hang seen on our setup with none of our mods, not proven for every setup | audit-confirmed: a crash (script error) or hang finding of the audited build that the docs/318 second review confirmed, static, not seen in game), reason, source (doc, issue or URL a human can check). Add an entry only with a source; no guessed entries.

entries.name: ^EnhancedWitches$
entries.reason: the game hung before the main menu with this package alone, twice, none of our mods installed (Steam 1.67 + Apex Radiance bridge; sha256 684514e4...11bb). Seen on our setup, not ours, not proven for every setup

entries.name: ^velocitygrass_AddAnyLotSize$
entries.reason: the world load never finished with this package alone, twice, none of our mods installed (Steam 1.67 + Apex Radiance bridge; sha256 316f12dc...2bad); a tester on the EA app 1.69.47 loads fine with it. Seen on our setup, not ours, not proven for every setup

entries.name: ^Buzz_(MakeNPCDoorFix|BuildBuyRestrictionChoker)$
entries.reason: Builder Stuff (MTS 450059): throws a script error on every world load, save load and world quit, so mods that hook in after it can miss their own load or quit step (crash, confirmed, static)

entries.name: ^ani_GetDrunk_1\.63$
entries.reason: Drinks for your Sims (MTS 399992), audited 1.63/1.67 build: in one rare case a script error stops that Sim's needs and moodlets from updating until the Sim is reset (crash, confirmed, static)

entries.name: ^TSS_MoreRomanticInteractions$
entries.reason: More Romantic Interactions v2 (MTS 691427): a script error in a lot's background update when a couch proposal has an Inappropriate or Insane bystander (crash, confirmed, static)

entries.name: ^ani_Dexter$
entries.reason: Dexter the Bear (MTS 372599): the arresting officer waits forever if the suspect cannot reach the police car (hang, confirmed, static, rare)

entries.name: ^Desecrate_WeaponsLib$
entries.reason: Weapons System (MTS 402950): the arresting officer waits forever if the suspect cannot reach the police car (hang, confirmed, static, rare)

entries.name: ^Enhanced Vampires$
entries.reason: Enhanced Vampires (MTS 648599): the Friendship, Romance and Hatred aura pulses always throw a script error (crash, confirmed, static)

entries.name: ^icarusallsorts\.PoolLifeguard(\.package)?$
entries.reason: Pool Jobs for Lifeguards (MTS 574660): a lifeguard who quits or is fired mid-shift still gets the rescue check and throws a script error; the base game has the same bug (crash, confirmed, static, rare)
